title: Touchpoint Lab: sync notes & outreach experiments (Priya)
body:
Purpose: quick lab notes for a 20–30m sync with AE Marcus and follow-up actions. Goal: triage two at-risk accounts, propose 2 outreach experiments, agree next steps for renewal playbook tweaks.

Context summary (one-liners):
- AltoHealth (Tier B, monthly spend $22k): dropped usage 37% last 6w after model change; ticket JIRA-CUST-3421 open; finance flagged potential downgrade.
- Shoply (Tier C, trial->paid): slow adoption of embeddings product; SE reported slow index-builds hitting timeouts on dedicated staging.

Quick metrics (pull from analytics dashboard):
- AltoHealth: calls/day 420 -> 265 (6w); avg latency +22% (server-side quantization rollout on 2026-01-15).
- Shoply: onboarding completion 40% vs target 70%; support MTTR 1.8d.

Agenda (top priority first):
1) 5m: alignment on what 'win' looks like for each account this quarter (renewal / upsell targets).
2) 10m: AltoHealth root-cause hypotheses + immediate mitigation options.
3) 8m: Shoply unblock plan + experiment to improve onboarding completion.
4) 5m: decide owners & timeline for playbook edits (renewal cadence + technical checklist).

Notes/Observations to mention: (short bullets, conversational)
- Marcus thinks AltoHealth cares most about immediate latency regressions; engineering says quantization rollouts were gated by perf tests but might have edge-case for long prompts.
- Customer mentioned they saw a change in token usage patterns after model switch (longer completions missing early stop tokens) — could be prompt/template issue.
- Shoply's SE (J. Park) added a repro that times out when embedding set >120k vectors in their self-managed index. Might be config issue with batch/window sizes.

Hypotheses (for discussion):
- H1 (Alto): quantization variant introduced degraded attention in long contexts causing slower token emission and more retries on client side -> perceived latency spike.
- H2 (Alto): customer prompt orchestration changed (new system prompt) increasing avg seq length; autoscaling thresholds not tuned for different seq distribution.
- H3 (Shoply): index-build timeouts caused by single-threaded ingestion in their connector; we can suggest parallel batching and backpressure configs.

Immediate mitigation options to propose (fast to test):
- Roll back AltoHealth to previous model variant for 48h (low friction) and monitor token rates. Owner: Marcus. Due: 2026-03-15.
- Short-term tweak: enable prefix caching for their most common prompt family to shave latency. Owner: SRE suggestion -> Hannah to coordinate with Eng. Due: 2026-03-17.
- For Shoply: provide a temporary hosted-scaling boost (Dedicated burst) to finish index build; request SE to run ingestion with smaller batch size. Owner: Priya + Solutions Eng (Diego). Due: 2026-03-19.

Conversation prompts for the sync (things to say):
- "If we prioritize rollback for 48h, what metrics do we want to watch to call it successful?"
- "Would Alto sign a short-term SLA credit if we can show 2 weeks of restored performance?"
- "For Shoply, can we get them to run ingestion with 8 parallel workers this week? If not, what is the blocker?"

Open questions (to capture & follow up):
- Can Eng produce a diff of the model artifacts between variants (quantization params) by EOD? -> ping @ml-runner.
- Is there billing sensitivity if we propose a temporary capacity bump for Shoply? Finance ok? (ask Sarah).
- Do we have alerting tied to per-customer seq-length distribution? If not, quick monitoring ask for Observability.

Experimental outreach ideas (A/B) — short templates:
- Email A (concise): Subject: "Quick fix proposal for recent latency at AltoHealth" Body: 3 bullets: explain rollback test, monitoring plan, ask for 48h sign-off.
- Email B (operational): Subject: "Can we run a short test on prefix caching?" Body: include timeline, minimal change list, rollback path, engineer contact.
- In-app CTA: offer a short scheduled call with engineering to run live repros; propose 30m window this week.

Follow-up actions (clear owners + dates):
- Marcus: Approve/decline rollback for AltoHealth and send note to customer. Due 2026-03-13.
- Hannah: Coordinate with SRE/Eng for prefix caching feasibility and timeline. Due 2026-03-17.
- Diego: Run Shoply ingestion with smaller batches and report run-time delta. Due 2026-03-18.
- Priya (me): Draft both email templates + in-app CTA and post to CS_ops Slack. Due 2026-03-13.
- Product: update renewal playbook with this 'rollback option' checkbox and a decision tree. Owner: TBD (product ops). Due 2026-03-26.

Notes-to-self (informal):
- Keep messages simple, avoid engineering jargon in customer-facing email.
- Save screenshots of dashboards (usage decline + latency curve) in the shared ticket.
- Mention that this is low-friction test (rollback + monitoring) to reduce customer hesitation.

Later ideas (if primary mitigations fail):
- Propose canary routing to alternative model variant regionally (longer term).
- Build a mini-runbook for seq-length regression detection tied to release checklist.

Quick checklist before sync: (tick once done)
- [ ] Attach latency chart to meeting invite
- [ ] Paste JIRA-CUST-3421 top comments into calendar note
- [ ] Share draft email templates in CS_ops
- [ ] Confirm Marcus can action rollback by EOD

Keywords for search later: "AltoHealth latency regression", "prefix-caching trial", "Shoply index timeout ingestion", "renewal playbook rollback"

End of note. Will convert to formal follow-up after sync and update linked tickets.
